description: Performance floor for TownSuite.WorkQueues.Server on the redis backend (Valkey 8.1). run_loadtest.sh runs every scenario with the server and Valkey limited to 2 CPUs and 1 GB each; a result outside these thresholds fails the build. Set on 2026-10-23 at about 50% of the throughput and 4x the p99 latency measured on a developer laptop. Tighten from the reports Jenkins archives (build/loadtest/report.json); loosen only with a reason in the commit message.
